Subject: New vendor setup — how should we submit first invoices?

Hi Rishi / Monica,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. We have two open questions before we submit our first invoice:

1) Do you want invoices uploaded to a Redwood vendor portal (URL?) or should we email them to accounts-payable@redwood.ai?
2) Is there a preferred invoice template for Redwood (PO number placement, remit-to text, tax breakdowns)? We attached our usual invoice (starlite_sample_invoice.xlsx) for reference — we can reformat if needed.

We have a standing PO: PO-78021. Will you need the PO on the invoice header, or is a line-level PO reference required? Also curious if subscription charges should show unit-level lines or a single plan line.

We'd like to avoid any delays on first payment — happy to hop on a 15-minute call if that's helpful.

Subject: Re: New vendor setup — how should we submit first invoices?

Hi Emily — thanks for the attachment and the clear questions. Short answers up front: portal preferred for ongoing invoices; email is ok for the first two invoices during onboarding if you include the PO and our vendor ID.

Details / requirements we need to match to avoid routing delays:
- Preferred channel: Redwood Vendor Portal (secure upload & automatic PO matching). We will send a portal invite after you complete our vendor form (link below).
- Email fallback: accounts-payable@redwood.ai — subject line must include "Vendor: Starlite Analytics | PO-78021" and attach a single PDF per invoice.
- Required fields: Redwood PO number (PO-78021) in header, vendor name, invoice number, invoice date, total, currency, and line-item breakdown if charges span multiple cost centers.
- For subscriptions: a single plan line is fine if you include the billing period (e.g., "July 2026 subscription — 1 seat"). Unit prices are optional for aggregated billing but required for per-seat reconciliations.
- Tax: include a separate tax line if applicable; we need tax registration country if different from billing address.
- Banking / remittance: include the remit-to bank name and account last 4 digits. We will not process invoices missing remit info.

I attached our vendor onboarding form (redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf) — once submitted, I will trigger the portal invite. If you prefer email for the first invoice, please convert the attached Excel to a single-page PDF and include the PO in the header.

Next steps:
1) Fill and e-sign the attached vendor onboarding form (DocuSign preferred). Link: https://app.redwood.ai/vendor-onboarding/forms/9823
2) Send one test invoice by email (PDF) to accounts-payable@redwood.ai with subject line noted above, or wait for the portal invite and upload there.

If you want, we can schedule a quick 15-min call tomorrow 11–11:30am PT to walk through the portal UI.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

- Credit memos: if we issue a credit, should that be uploaded with a reference to the original Redwood invoice number or PO?

Subject: Re: New vendor setup — how should we submit first invoices?

Hi Emily — welcome, and thanks for confirming you'll complete the vendor form. A couple of clarifications from a PO / AP processing perspective: 

- Invoice numbering: we accept your standard sequential invoice numbers. Please include your invoice number in the PDF filename and in the header of the document.
- Combined PDFs: please submit one invoice per PDF when possible. If you send a batch file (e.g., month-end consolidated), include a cover page listing the invoice numbers and a map to the PDF pages. That expedites processing, but our default expectation is one invoice = one PDF.
- Credit memos: reference the original invoice number in the credit memo and the PO where applicable (credit memos should be uploaded with a short note in the portal or email body).
- Exceptions: if the invoice is for professional services needing SOW references, include the SOW id on the invoice header. For tax-exempt customers please add the exemption certificate number as an attachment.

We will provision the vendor portal once we get the signed onboarding form. The portal enforces PDF uploads and auto-extracts PO and invoice number to reduce manual routing. If you need our portal guide, I'll send it after your form is processed.

Phone availability: I can join the call tomorrow 11–11:30am PT if Rishi is available — otherwise we can do asynchronous check-ins.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Senior Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
